verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say users can set up two-factor authentication in the Account Console, and the admin guide covers 'WebAuthn together with Two-Factor'. A hands-on user also reports running 2FA across 10+ services. The evidence never names TOTP authenticator apps, backup/recovery codes, admin-enforced MFA requirements, or step-up authentication. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP/OTP authenticator support, backup/recovery codes, admin policy to require MFA for all users, step-up enforcement (e.g., per-client or ACR-based), and in-depth docs for these.
